title: Select a range of time, across clips and tracks, and act on it
goal: User 2026-09-28: 'I keep expecting to be able to select a range either as a marquee selection or range selection from dragging a range on the header line. This could let me for example select parts from 2 clips on a track and then collapsing that range into one clip. Or adding a transition.' Premiere has In/Out ranges and marquee selection; Final Cut has the Range tool (R). Photonz has In/Out marks (c21c0fc1) but no drag-to-select range and no marquee on the timeline.
notes: Filed from the intake window. 2026-09-28: split. Merge into One Clip + Break Apart -> merge-a-range-into-one-clip-and-break-it-apart-a; marquee and Option-drag/R track range -> marquee-over-the-tracks-and-a-range-limited-to-t; Cmd-C/X/V of a range -> copy-cut-and-paste-a-range-of-time. Built: PhotonzCore/RulerRange.swift (grip, drawn, moving, markRange, splitEveryClip(atEdgesOf:), putTransitionOnEveryCut(within:), CaptionCues.replacing), Photonz/EditorState+RulerRange.swift, TimelineDock ruler gesture/band/wash, dragRuler walk step.
acceptance: Drag on the ruler (the time header) to select a time range across all tracks, shown as a tinted band with handles you can drag to adjust; click elsewhere on the ruler clears it; it sets In and Out too

Right-click a range: Add Transition (at the cuts inside the range), Split at Range Edges, Delete, Ripple Delete (Delete is Premiere's Lift, Ripple Delete its Extract), Add Captions for Range, Export Range
Keys: Delete and Shift-Delete act on the range; Cmd-T puts the default transition on every cut inside it
Walk at Next defaults: two clips on a track with a cut between; drag a range across the cut on the ruler, Add Transition, undo, Split at Range Edges, Delete, Shift-Delete; photograph each step

log.note: Pre-build review. What exists: In/Out marks on the ruler (markedRangeMS), Extract/Lift over every unlocked track, a ruler right-click menu, ⌘T default transition and putTransitionOnEveryCut(among clips). What the ask collides with: a press or drag anywhere on the ruler scrubs today (Premiere habit). Resolution: a drag that starts ON the playhead still scrubs; a drag anywhere else draws the range (sets In and Out in one undo step); a plain click moves the playhead and, outside the marked stretch, clears it; a drag on either edge of the band moves that edge. The transport scrub bar, J/K/L and arrows still scrub. Delete/Shift-Delete: Premiere meaning (Delete leaves the gap = Lift, Shift-Delete closes it = Extract), only while the range is the thing in hand (drawn, and no clip picked since). What the app cannot deliver: 'Merge into One Clip' needs a clip that holds other clips (Premiere Nest / Final Cut compound clip) which the model has no notion of; a marquee over the tracks needs piece-level multi-selection; copy/paste of a stretch of time needs a timeline clipboard. Those three go to their own p1 tasks sequenced right after this one; this run builds the ruler range, its band across the tracks, its right-click actions and keys.
walks draw-a-range-on-the-ruler-walk, draw-a-range-by-hand-walk -> draw-a-range-on-the-ruler-walk, draw-a-range-by-hand-walk, captions-and-export-for-a-range-walk
